title: ApprovalRules
description: One layer of a run's approval policy (P2.6c): a decision per effect class and per tool id; anything absent is allow. Layers only narrow one another (deny > ask > allow). `writes` is the one switch: it sets both write and execute. Never null: a layer says nothing about a class by omitting it. `flow` is the layer's flow rule (SEC1, per org since SEC2): an external write after the run read data above `above` is asked for or denied; the effective rule is the strictest of the deployment's and every layer's, and `off` never widens another layer.

LayerFlow.description: `level` for an external write once the run's context is above `above` (default `public`: any private or unknown source).

FlowLevel.description: What an external write gets once the run's context is above the threshold: nothing (`off`), a question, or a refusal.

FlowThreshold.description: The context sensitivity above which the flow rule applies.
